                        <div class="category">
                                    <h1 class="uk-article-title">Uncharted Villas</h1>
                                    <p><img src="/images/villas/villas-featured-banner.jpg" alt="Uncharted Villas" width="1200" /></p>
<h4>Welcome to Uncharted Villas!</h4>
<p>Uncharted Villas is your own slice of paradise in Cabarete with stunning views of the ocean and direct access to the beach. These sprawling luxurious condos are located in the heart of Kite Beach, Cabarete. Spectacular ocean and pool views from the expansive balconies help you relax while watching colorful kites glide by on the azul horizon.</p>
<p>These 1,800 square foot oceanfront residences offer 2 bedroom, 2 bath units with fully equipped kitchens, family rooms, office areas, in suite laundry, spacious terraces with dining table seating for six alongside sun chairs, private elevators and a sublime ocean front pool in a gated complex with 24-hour security. If you need to mix work and play while in paradise, appreciate secure private American IP high speed fiber optic wifi that guarantees your video conferencing calls and critical emails will always get through. Every unit has full cable American provided programming including international news channels, a dozen sports channels like ESPN, over a dozen movie channels like HBO, Showtime, Encore, Starz, Cinemax and more. Your home on the beach is the ultimate combination of work and play.</p>
<p>For the kiters coming to frolic in the world class conditions of Cabarete, we have an onsite air compressor for you to easily pump your kites, and our large lawn is the perfect place for you to roll your gear when you're done shredding. Beach showers and water hoses are provided for you to rinse off yourself and your gear. For kite and surf gear storage, locker rentals are available for holiday use and long term rentals.</p>
<p>The fully equipped kitchens with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, dishwashers, microwaves, coffee makers, blenders, electric hand-mixers, and toasters bring out the inner chef in any family. The master bedrooms have spectacular views of the pool and ocean, and en-suite private baths including bathtub/shower, double sinks, and 2 large mirrored closets to hold your belongings. The guest bedrooms have queen-size beds, 2 large mirrored closets, and a bathroom located next to the bedroom for convenience.</p>
<p>All terraces overlook the meticulously manicured garden that offers front-row views of the pool and the famous Kite Beach. Watch the family enjoy the beach side pool while appreciating the kite surfers and horses pass by as you relax on the terrace. The condominium complex is close to family-friendly activities, public transport, the airport, nightlife, and the city center. Just 25 minutes from Puerto Plata Airport (POP), Cabarete is the mecca for water sports and outdoor adventure in the Caribbean. Located on Kite Beach and 1.5 km from the center of town. Caba Reef is a quiet, peaceful atmosphere that allows you to enjoy the sporty vibe of the region.</p>
<p>You’ll love our place because of the ocean views, the direct access to the beach, the kite and family-friendly atmosphere, and the care and consideration taken into every aspect of your stay from the impeccable cleaning, to onsite owners who are here to provide you with anything you need. Uncharted Villas are fantastic for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, and families (with infants and children) who want to be close to the ocean and live in sublime comfort. Reserve your stay at Uncharted Villas and fall in love with the ocean, and those people who you share your experiences with.</p>
<h5>Stay salty!</h5>
